description: Start a Stripe Checkout for one prepaid credit pack for the caller's organization, and return its page for the person to open and pay there. Nothing is charged until they pay on that page. Only organization owners and admins may call it. Needs a credential.

pack.description: Prepaid credit pack, named by its price in US dollars. Credits are $0.05 each, and larger packs add bonus credits.

name: start_credit_checkout

url.description: The Stripe page for the person to open in a browser and finish there. Stripe expires it, so call again for a fresh one.

title: Start credit checkout
